newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU provisionally agrees ERM2, legal status of euro.
newsitem.headline: EU provisionally agrees ERM2, legal status of euro.

text.p: European Union leaders provisionally agreed on Friday to plans for a post-single currency exchange rate mechanism and the legal status of the euro, although final approval was linked to agreement on the stability pact, an EU diplomat said.
"All the elements have been agreed for ERM 2 and the legal status," he said.

The diplomat said the leaders, meeting in a summit in Dublin, had raced through various issues on their agenda in order to get to the issue that still divides them, the stability pact aimed at enforcing fiscal discipline under monetary union.
The legal basis of the euro and the ERM 2, which is designed to keep currencies outside the euro bloc stable, are part of the same report as the stability pact.
The leaders cannot at this stage formally endorse one part without the rest.
